name: stock_posting_mark
description: GH #3748 / REQ-713, decision 0073 (Consequences, cost note), docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md section 9.2. The bookkeeping record that says a stock document was posted (mark posted) or reversed (mark reversed). It is written only by the write handlers post_document and reverse_document of module stock, in the same transaction as the ledger entry (HandlerWrites.create/3 and post/3). document_id is the id of the versioned document, document_type its type key, version_no the issued version, org_unit_id the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7), reason_code the reversal reason (set on a reversed mark only). The unique constraint uq_stock_posting_mark_doc_mark allows one posted and one reversed mark per document: a second completion of a posting for the same document violates it, so the whole completion transaction rolls back before any ledger write.
